# USA Curling

> > The official website for USA Curling, providing membership information, event registrations, and resources for curling athletes and enthusiasts in the United States.

USA Curling is the national governing body for the Olympic sport of curling in the United States. The organization manages athlete development, competitions, memberships, and provides resources for curlers at all levels from recreational to elite Olympic competition.

## Key Topics

- Membership registration
- Event registration
- Competitive curling
- Olympic curling
- USA Curling membership
- Athlete development
- Curling clubs
- Tournament registration
- Curling events
- National championships
- Youth curling
- High performance programs
- Coaching certification
- Officials training

## Membership & Registration

- [Membership Upgrades and Event Registration Support](https://usacurling.org/press-releases/membership-registration): USA Curling online meeting for membership upgrades and event registration help
